title: Strategic Account Sprint Queue with Timeboxed Commitment Windows
creator: Aria Patel
description:
Problem statement: Key enterprise customers regularly escalate product requests that require rapid product commitments. Current intake is ad hoc, causing scope creep, unclear delivery timelines, and unscoped engineering work that displaces planned roadmap items. We need a durable, timeboxed "Strategic Account Sprint Queue" to accept narrowly-scoped, high-impact asks from top accounts with explicit commitment windows, clear acceptance criteria, and engineering capacity guardrails.

Goal: Create a lightweight process and UI hooks in the Console to triage escalations from strategic accounts into a timeboxed sprint queue that: (1) standardizes required intake artifacts, (2) enforces a maximum commitment window (e.g., 6 weeks) for build or scoped-delivery, (3) surfaces tradeoffs to Sales/Customer Success, and (4) provides telemetry (impact, cost, latency to delivery) to PM/ENG to track runway and outcomes.

Out of scope: full automation of prioritization algorithm and long-term billing terms. This is a product/process workstream + small Console UX to capture and expose commitments to stakeholders.
acceptance_criteria: Published process doc describing intake artifacts, decision gates, and 3-tier eligibility criteria for the sprint queue
Console mock that captures required intake fields (business impact, critical path, success metrics, suggested scope) and exposes commitment windows to Sales/CS
Pilot with 3 strategic accounts documented with signed intake forms and accepted commitment windows
Engineering capacity guardrail mechanism: a weekly visible cap (story points or % of sprint) that prevents over-commitment in planning
Telemetry dashboard that tracks time from intake to ship, number of scope changes, and customer satisfaction post-delivery
tasks: Draft process playbook and eligibility rubric (owner: PM)
Collaborate with Design on minimal Console intake modal and commitment banner (owner: DES)
Work with Eng to expose a planning cap in sprint planning tooling (owner: ENG)
Legal/CS: create a one-page intake acknowledgement template for Sales to sign
Pilot intake with 3 customers and collect feedback
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Sales circumvents process for very large deals -> Mitigation: require CS+Legal acknowledgement for any ad-hoc commitments
Risk: Engineering capacity swallowed by repeated scope churn -> Mitigation: enforce hard weekly cap and mandatory re-scope if >2 scope revisions
Risk: Perceived unfair prioritization by non-strategic customers -> Mitigation: publish eligibility rubric and statistics on how many requests accepted vs rejected
metrics: Mean time from intake to delivery (target < 42 days for sprint queue items)
% of sprint capacity consumed by strategic queue (target < 20% per sprint)
Number of scope revisions per ticket (target <= 1)
plan_and_timeline: Week 0-1: Write playbook, alignment with Sales/CS/Legal
Week 2: Design mocks for Console intake modal and commitment banner
Week 3-4: Eng implements planning cap flag and lightweight API endpoint for intake records
Week 5-6: Pilot with 3 customers, collect telemetry
Week 7: Retrospective and public docs; decision to iterate or scale
